meta.name: TURN Washingtons Spies 720p
meta.description:
The story of New York farmer, Abe Woodhull, who bands together with a group of childhood friends to form The Culper Ring, an unlikely group of spies who turn the tide in America’s fight for independence.

Rated TV-14 · Ended · First aired 6 Apr 2014 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: AMC Studios, Sesfonstein Productions, Josephson Entertainment · Network: AMC

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10 | S3 10/10 | S4 10/10

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: During the early years of the Revolutionary War, a Long Island farmer is recruited to spy on the British army.

videos.title: Who by Fire
videos.overview: To prevent Anna being blamed for the murder of a Royal Officer, Abe must find the culprit; Ben and Caleb interrogate Simcoe.

videos.title: Of Cabbages and Kings
videos.overview: On the run from the British, Ben is betrayed by his own militia. Abe travels with Richard to New York to spy. Mary confronts Anna.

videos.title: Eternity How Long
videos.overview: Abe and Richard grapple with orders to dig up gravestones; Ben and Caleb try to get their intelligence to General Washington.

videos.title: Epiphany
videos.overview: Celeb and Ben follow mysterious orders; Washington's army crosses into enemy territory.

videos.title: Mr. Culpeper
videos.overview: Abe heads to New York and runs into a desperate patriot along the way. Ben is tasked with creating America's first spy ring.

videos.title: Mercy Moment Murder Measure
videos.overview: An old threatening presence returns to Setauket, worrying Abe that Anna is no longer protected.

videos.title: Challenge
videos.overview: Anna looks for enemy intelligence at an exclusive gentleman's party against Abe's wishes.

videos.title: Against Thy Neighbor
videos.overview: Simcoe tries to hunt out the rebel conspirators in Setauket. Ben is sent away on a secret mission.

videos.title: The Battle of Setauket
videos.overview: Mary struggles when she realizes that Abe is a spy working for the other side. Ben and Caleb hope to save Patriot families when they carry out a raid on Setauket.

videos.title: Thoughts of a Free Man
videos.overview: A spy in London sends an urgent message to America. Mary impedes Abe's attempt to restart the spy ring. Benedict Arnold arrives in camp.

videos.title: Hard Boiled
videos.overview: Abe gathers intelligence in New York. Simcoe escapes his punishment. John André attends a ball in Philadelphia and meets Peggy Shippen.

videos.title: False Flag
videos.overview: Ben sets a trap to capture a traitor in camp. Richard discovers Abe is conspiring with Major Hewlett. Caleb collides with Robert Rogers.

videos.title: Men of Blood
videos.overview: Abe tries to recruit a new agent; Caleb and Rogers race to hunt down intelligence from London; Andre's history is exposed.

videos.title: Sealed Fate
videos.overview: Abe makes one last effort to recruit a spy inside New York. Ben must determine who is a double agent.

videos.title: Houses Divided
videos.overview: Anna, Ben, and Caleb devise ways of rescuing the abducted Major Hewlett. Mary attempts to motivate Judge Woodhull into action.

videos.title: Valley Forge
videos.overview: George Washington teeters on the edge of madness. Abe and Hewlett endure great hardships at the hands of their respective captors, though the latter's ends unexpectedly.

videos.title: Providence
videos.overview: The French join the fray. Caleb makes an uncomfortable trip and Abe makes an even more uncomfortable choice. Robert Rodgers finds himself unexpectedly unemployed.

videos.title: The Prodigal
videos.overview: Abe returns from prison with critical intel. Tensions rise between Hewlett and Simcoe. Arnold rescues Peggy from a rebel mob.

videos.title: Gunpowder, Treason, and Plot
videos.overview: Abe plots to assassinate Major Hewlett, then receives a proposition from an unlikely ally. Ben fights at the Battle of Monmouth (June 28, 1778). Benedict Arnold continues to covet Peggy Shippen.

videos.title: Valediction
videos.overview: In the third-season premiere, Abe covers up a murder with an unlikely accomplice. Elsewhere, Benedict Arnold abuses his power as he settles into a new home in Philadelphia.

videos.title: Cold Murdering Bastards
videos.overview: Anna tries to save the ring after Abe's cover is blown. Benedict Arnold  seeks Washington's help against charges of treason. Townsend sends a  signal.

videos.title: Benediction
videos.overview: Peggy gets Benedict Arnold to contact the British. Caleb plans an ambush for Simcoe. Anna tries to save Major Hewlett.

videos.title: Hearts and Minds
videos.overview: Ben is rescued by a mysterious woman. Abe tries to stop Anna from  marrying Hewlett. Arnold begins negotiations with the British. Andre  betrays Peggy.

videos.title: Hypocrisy, Fraud, and Tyranny
videos.overview: Townsend uncovers a British counterfeiting operation. Rogers threatens to destroy Abe's spying ring. Simcoe threatens Richard.

videos.title: Many Mickles Make a Muckle
videos.overview: Washington goes to Benedict Arnold's Philadelphia ball. Abe tries to stop Rogers from reaching Townsend. Old friends and enemies collide.

videos.title: Judgment
videos.overview: Mary attempts to kill Simcoe by herself. Benedict Arnold defends himself in his court-martial. Ben reunites with his savior.

videos.title: Mended
videos.overview: The Culper Ring is resurrected in time to save Washington's army. Simcoe terrorizes Setauket as he hunts for Rogers. Anna infiltrates New York.

videos.title: Blade on the Feather
videos.overview: Benedict Arnold plots to give West Point to the British. Andre negotiates for Peggy. Abe plots a revolt in Setauket.

videos.title: Trial and Execution
videos.overview: The captured spies on both sides of the war head to the gallows. Benedict Arnold demands glory revenge.

videos.title: Spyhunter General
videos.overview: Benedict Arnold rounds up spies in New York. Abe plots to destroy essential British supplies, but he will need his father's help.

videos.title: The Black Hole of Calcutta
videos.overview: When one of the Culper Ring members is captured, Arnold seeks to interrogate him - with the help of a ruthless Colonel Simcoe.

videos.title: Blood for Blood
videos.overview: Abe's scheme to rescue Caleb turns deadly. Anna faces a difficult decision. Arnold suspects Peggy is keeping a secret from him.

videos.title: Nightmare
videos.overview: Amidst a growing rebellion in camp, the Culper Ring must chart a new course. Arnold finds an unlikely ally. Rivington teaches Townsend a lesson.

videos.title: Private Woodhull
videos.overview: Seeking revenge against Simcoe, Abe travels to New York and meets Benedict Arnold. A visitor from Anna's past comes to the continental camp.

videos.title: Our Man in New York
videos.overview: The plot to kidnap Benedict Arnold is hatched; Peggy learns Cicero's secret; Washington and the French clash over strategy.

videos.title: Quarry
videos.overview: Ben's plan to kidnap Benedict Arnold conflicts with Abe's plan to kill Simcoe; changing loyalties turn enemies into allies.

videos.title: Belly of the Beast
videos.overview: Abe and Simcoe settle their score; Ben appeals to Gen. Washington; Townsend risks everything while Caleb seeks redemption.

videos.title: Reckoning
videos.overview: Washington heads south to lay siege on Yorktown; Abe volunteers for the Continental Army; Peggy goes into labor.

videos.title: Washington's Spies
videos.overview: The fate of the Culper Ring is revealed; the American War of Independence comes to an end; a settling of accounts between shadows and spies; America struggles to begin.
